report.explanation: Gateway metrics show low error rate (0.0014), p95 79ms, zero dependency timeouts and no pool waiters, and logs show successful 200s, contradicting the alert. The only error is a single gateway->inventory trace span at ~1019ms. Current evidence is insufficient to bound a root cause; handoff with the listed missing observations.
missing_evidence: Traces for order, inventory, payment, and postgresql services in the alert window to locate the failing hop
Inventory service metrics (latency, error rate, redis timeouts) to test downstream-latency or redis-timeout
Gateway-to-inventory call error detail (status code, timeout vs 5xx) to distinguish http-500 from downstream-latency
Order service metrics/logs to confirm whether the gateway error originates in order or inventory
